record_title: Harmonic-resonance obstructions for weighted critical Hardy--Rellich inequalities
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Castro v4 and the relevant theorem/proof/concluding passages of Majdoub v1 were inspected. McOwen (1979), a potentially relevant general weighted-Sobolev/Fredholm source, was not inspected in full; only bibliographic metadata and secondary theorem descriptions were available. The record does not characterize nonresonant Laplacian weights outside the Muckenhoupt interval. No independent validation is asserted.
